# Cretes Programming Language

> Cretes is a modern compiled systems programming language engineered for uncompromising performance, deterministic memory safety without garbage collection, and expressive developer ergonomics.

## Overview & Core Documentation
- [Official Website](https://cretes.org): Project portal, documentation gateway, and community hubs.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Cretes-lang/cretes): Compiler implementation, CLI toolchain, and standard library source.
- [Language Specification](https://cretes.org/SPECIFICATION.md): Formal grammar, type system, ownership semantics, and memory model.
- [Language Specification (Plaintext)](https://cretes.org/spec.txt): Raw plaintext mirror of the language specification.
- [Language Tour & Examples](https://github.com/Cretes-lang/cretes/tree/main/examples): Real-world code examples demonstrating concurrency, memory management, and data structures.
- [Getting Started Guide](https://github.com/Cretes-lang/cretes): Installation instructions, toolchain configuration, and Hello World walkthrough.

## Design Philosophy & Features
- **Deterministic Memory Safety**: Compile-time ownership, borrowing, and lifetime verification without runtime garbage collection pauses.
- **Zero-Cost Abstractions**: High-level patterns (iterators, closures, generics, pattern matching) compile directly to optimal machine code.
- **Native Performance**: LLVM-based backend producing statically linked native binaries with minimal overhead.
- **Modern Concurrency**: First-class async/await runtime, channels, and structured concurrency preventing data races at compile time.
- **Modern Toolchain**: Integrated package management, formatting, linting, testing, and documentation generation out of the box.

## Ecosystem, Governance & Security
- [RFC Process & Catalog](https://cretes.org/RFCs.md): Technical design proposals, language changes, and evolutionary RFCs.
- [RFC Index (JSON)](https://cretes.org/rfcs.json): Machine-readable RFC index and metadata.
- [Project Governance](https://cretes.org/GOVERNANCE.md): Project leadership, sub-teams, and consensus decision-making model.
- [Contribution Guidelines](https://cretes.org/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to submit patches, compiler tests, and bug fixes.
- [Security Policy](https://cretes.org/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting, security disclosures, and RFC 9116 metadata.
- [Code of Conduct](https://cretes.org/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): Contributor Covenant v2.1 community standards.
- [License](https://cretes.org/LICENSE): Official Apache-2.0 open source license.
- [Machine-Readable Releases](https://cretes.org/releases.json): JSON metadata of binary artifacts and compiler releases.
- [Release Checksums](https://cretes.org/CHECKSUMS.txt): Cryptographic SHA256 checksums for release distributions.
- [Supply Chain Provenance](https://cretes.org/provenance.json): SLSA v1.0 Level 3 build provenance attestation.
- [AI Crawler Policy](https://cretes.org/ai.txt): Machine-readable crawler permissions and ingestion endpoints.

## Full LLM Ingestion
- [llms-full.txt](https://cretes.org/llms-full.txt): Complete consolidated language manual, full grammar specifications, standard library overview, and comprehensive code samples in a single ingestion-ready file.
